page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.3xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture with a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. The instance provides 6 physical cores and 12 virtual CPUs with multithreading enabled under dedicated CPU allocation. Memory capacity totals 24 GB, establishing a 2 GB per vCPU ratio supported by 48 MB of L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and FMA. Baseline network bandwidth is 8 Gbps. Dedicated local storage and GPU accelerators are not included with this instance model.

Benchmark testing places the instance within average performance tiers across standard execution suites. The ecs.c7.3xlarge records a Geekbench single-core score of 1531.0 and a multi-core score of 7760.0, along with a multi-core stress-ng rating of 11644.69. Memory bandwidth tests yield 76.48 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 46.87 GB/sec for uncached writes. Synthetic application tests measure 11.74 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 15.7 GB/sec. Small language model (135M parameter) processing achieves 1068.44 prompt tokens per second, but prompt execution speed drops to 23.52 tokens per second on 7B parameter models, reflecting lower performance for medium-size model processing.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation provides standard density for compute-centric tasks that do not require high memory-per-core headroom. Relying entirely on remote storage requires network disk provisioning for persistent data. The lack of integrated GPU accelerators restricts performance on complex machine learning training workflows. The server is configured for software compilation, web serving, key-value data caching, and intermediate batch processing tasks.
